gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patients with histologically confirmed glioblastoma at unequivocal first recurrence or progression according to RANO criteria.

candidate_evidence.quote: L19TNF is a fully human fusion protein consisting of human tumor necrosis factor (TNF)-α fused to the L19 antibody in scFv format, specific to the extra-domain B of fibronectin.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: A Study to Evaluate Safety and Efficacy of L19TNF Plus Lomustine in Patients With Glioblastoma at First Progression

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational antibody-cytokine fusion protein (L19 scFv anti-EDB fibronectin fused to TNF-alpha)
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: selective delivery of TNF to the tumour site via L19 antibody against extra-domain B of fibronectin; TNF induces apoptosis/necrosis and inflammation/immunity

role_evidence.quote: 118 Patients will be randomized 1:1 and treated with either lomustine on day 1 and L19TNF on Days 1, 3 and 5, and on Days 22, 24, and 26 of a 42-days cycle at the RD established in the phase I part of the study or with lomustine on day 1 of a 42-days cycle.

agents.drug_class_hint: nitrosourea alkylating agent, established GBM therapy

coder_notes: Lomustine is given in every arm (backbone in phase 2 randomisation, lomustine alone as control), so soc_backbone; in the phase 1 part lomustine dose varies between cohorts (90 vs 110 mg/m2) as part of combination dose finding, which might be read as rule 6 (established_therapy_experiment) for that part, but the investigational question is L19TNF. The phase 2 lomustine-alone control (Treatment Arm 2) sits inside an EXPERIMENTAL-labelled registered arm, hence control_arm_from_other_arms yes. MGMT requirement is only that status is known (no value required); coded eligibility but does not select a molecular subgroup. IDH-wildtype is diagnostic.
